defects.observed: It may contain multiple statements about its ID, Name, ordered/unordered contents, Label, Navigation Number and connections.
defects.conflicts_with_direct_decision: A Declaration can cover declared Scope Unit ID, Name, ordered/unordered, Label, even Navigation Number, and connections.
defects.why: 'contents' changes the decided Scope Unit property into a claim about its contents and adds ambiguity not present in the Operator wording.
defects.minimal_fix: Replace 'ordered/unordered contents' with 'ordered/unordered status' (or the exact decision wording 'ordered/unordered').

confirmed_alignment.decision_quote: exactly ONE Declaration and ONE OR MORE separate Goals outside the declared Scope Unit. Do not put Goals into Declaration operative Claim.

confirmed_alignment.topic: plural internal Contracts, RMEDO as applicable
confirmed_alignment.decision_quote: Inside: Scope Contract ATOMS, plural, tier 0, RMEDO as applicable; not exactly one and not forced all five roles.

confirmed_alignment.topic: multiple-statement Declaration Form and no invented GFEL
confirmed_alignment.decision_quote: Declaration can contain multiple statements, in prose, GFEL formal expressions, or both, about one coherent topic. No invented GFEL syntax/functions.
Rejected extra per-unit Definition Atom: Declaration plus Contracts sufficient.

confirmed_alignment.topic: Draft-only form-field proposal and no present reader admission
confirmed_alignment.decision_quote: Technical type-to-form field is deliberately proposed Draft field only, not reader admission.
Adoption/cutover not yet authorized in this Draft task.

unsettled_decisions_not_defects.reason: The packet preserves the express decision that Project Goal ownership does not settle Project Declaration ownership.

unsettled_decisions_not_defects.question: Is Navigation Number authored or derived from declared order?
unsettled_decisions_not_defects.reason: The packet records the gap and creates no format or derivation rule.

unsettled_decisions_not_defects.question: Must every declared unit have at least one explicit local Contract?
unsettled_decisions_not_defects.reason: The latest decision rejects exactly-one and all-roles requirements but does not decide a minimum; the packet does not falsely resolve it.
